newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Airways extends limit high run.
newsitem.headline: Thai Airways extends limit high run.

text.p: Thai Airways International Plc reached its 10 percent daily limit high for the fifth consecutive session on Monday as investors welcomed its prospective foreign exchange gains from the baht depreciation.

Brokers said Thai Airways, owned about 93 percent by the government, surged 5.00 baht to 55.00 from the opening with a long list of unmatched bids. The carrier has advanced 44.7 percent since June 30 when it closed at 38.00 baht.

Brokers estimated that over 70 percent of Thai Airways' revenue is denominated in foreign currencies, which would give it hefty foreign exchange gains after the baht fell more than 15 percent in the wake of its float from early last week.
Thai Airways posted 3.38 billion baht ($118.6 million) net profit in the year ended September 30, 1996, against 3.24 billion a year earlier.
